column1: # nixpkgs attr <TAB> the names Debian (popcon) or Arch (pkgstats) give the same
# program, where they differ from the attr and the pname. The first name is
# also a name the Install search finds it by ("code" finds vscode). A name
# with "!" is ANOTHER program's of that name (Arch's "graphite" is the font
# engine on every machine, not the Graphite editor).
